newsitem.title: USA: Republican Bob Smith loses New Hampshire Senate seat.
newsitem.headline: Republican Bob Smith loses New Hampshire Senate seat.

text.p: New Hampshire Republican Sen. Bob Smith on Tuesday lost his re-election bid to Democrat Dick Swett, a former representative, according to network television projections.

The loss is a blow for Republicans and brings Democrats closer to the net gain of three seats they need to regain effective control of the 100-member chamber. Swett would be the first Democratic senator from New Hampshire in 21 years. The state, usually a reliable Republican stronghold, also voted for President Clinton.
